A '''hunting bow''' is a ranged weapon that can be found within various {{MCD|mission}}s. Its unique variants are the {{MCD|Master's Bow|master's bow}}, the {{MCD|Hunter's Promise|hunter's promise}}, and the {{MCD|Ancient Bow|ancient bow}}.

==Obtaining==
===Missions===
''<small>Listed difficulties are considered to be the minimum difficulty the item is obtainable on unless stated otherwise.</small>''
*{{DuLevelLink|Soggy Swamp}}
*{{DuLevelLink|Soggy Cave}}
*{{DuLevelLink|Panda Plateau}} (DLC)
*{{DuLevelLink|Nether Fortress}} (DLC)
*{{DuLevelLink|End Wilds}} (DLC)
*{{DuLevelLink|Tower}}

===Merchants===
*{{DuEntityLink|Village Merchant}}
*{{DuEntityLink|Gift Wrapper}}
*{{DuEntityLink|Mystery Merchant}}
*{{DuEntityLink|Luxury Merchant}}
*{{DuEntityLink|Piglin Merchant}}

===Ancients===
*{{DuEntityLink|The Tower (mob)}}

==Usage==
When the hero hits a [[MCD:Mob|mob]] with a hunting bow, any pets they [[MCD:Artifact#Summoning Artifacts|summoned with an artifact]] attack the targeted mob.

===Properties===
*X ranged damage
*Pets attack targeted mobs

===Stats===
*Multiplier: 1-2
*Quiver: 53

==Data values==
*Hunting bows use two internal, hidden enchantments.  
**The first one, <code>HuntingBowEnchantment</code>, is used by the game to make companions attack targeted mobs.
**The second one, <code>HuntingBowTaggedEnchantment</code>, is used by the game to apply a target over the head of any mob struck with an arrow.
